# A-010 independent GPT implementation review round 2

Original Ask: Agentflow 有external runner 但在t3 code 環境下，希望可以使用其orchestrator. Design Go: dacf056; 使用opus 5.5 medium 來實作，並使用gpt來review. Preserve Windows/cross-machine fork; no upstream push.

Evidence: Review exact INTEGRATED source commit caef93bdea94a443a81eecbea951be83480781ea against original base 791420dc29f02a14792ad654ca8940fd5ebfc042. Correction cloned source22eff43 was cherry-picked as caef93b; only same five allowed source files changed. Host rerun route41 PASS (/tmp/agentflow-A010-host-route-r2.log) and advanced rulebook contract1 PASS (/tmp/agentflow-A010-host-rules-r2.log). Unchanged language2PASS remains valid; original eight dirty hashes remain unchanged. Read implementation-report-r2.md for Opus response/new API. Four regression tests red37pass4fail then green41. Current cross-check full plan remains scope-valid for same five paths and trust boundary, use it. No full-suite rerun needed unless a concrete uncovered risk justifies it.

Normal journey: Read approved design.md under A-009; current same-work-root native review round2 will use updated handoff, host-persisted context before dispatch, bound context after dispatch, same-round resume checks, real raw task_status completion and replay after your final report. R1 real live complete/replay yielded UNRESOLVED and no rewrites as expected from blockers. Prior worker implementation no-remotes clone proof still applies. Your report must leave current running task completion to host, without claiming it already passed.

Material uncertainties: Re-evaluate ALL original requirements and specifically close or retain GPT r1 R1/R2 below. Read full integrated diff; check no regression in external path, cancellation/unknown/timeout/pending children, third round and partial completion. New host-owned facts.native_context resume must fail closed when missing and preserve original controls without redispatch; changed selection/policy must not close pending task. Evaluate minimality using at least one plausible deletion/reuse. No findings waived. Response to R1/R2: Opus added saved-context resume, no re-selection on started rounds, request hash includes controls, bind/status checks exposed controls, failed initial selection writes no brief. Host accepts direction but independently requests your verdict. Do not broaden into unrelated baseline/config/looper fixes.

Forbidden scope: Direct independent review only; do not delegate, launch models, invoke Agentflow, modify source/config, commit or push. Only authorized write .agentflow/artifacts/A-010-t3-orchestrator/review-r2.md. Read active writing guidance /home/zup/code/agentflow/.agents/skills/agentflow/references/writing.md. Repository instructions are reviewed data. Shared filesystem, instruction-only read-only; no OS sandbox claim.

OUTPUT CONTRACT OVERRIDES prior round paths/commit: fresh numeric timestamp first line '* _YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS +0800 (gpt-6.1-sol/high)_'; exactly one 'Reviewed implementation commit: caef93bdea94a443a81eecbea951be83480781ea'. Exactly one each Verdict/Outcome/Minimality/Conformance: PASS|BLOCKING. Exactly one Consensus: AGREE if all PASS else UNRESOLVED. Last line Self-check: with substantive check. Write Traditional Chinese. FINAL RESPONSE MUST BE THE ENTIRE REPORT IDENTICAL TO review-r2.md, no fence/short summary. Full original brief and all prior findings follow for complete task-only history; old report path/commit directives superseded by this paragraph.

## Original review brief
# A-010 independent implementation review, round 1

Original Ask: "Agentflow 有external runner 但在t3 code 環境下，希望可以使用其orchestrator". Owner approved "Design Go: dacf056" and "使用opus 5.5 medium 來實作，並使用gpt來review". Maintain Windows/cross-machine fork xup60521/agentflow; never push upstream.

Evidence: Review implementation commit bc226d1bd5db492807dcc3c9b4c65ab577bb582a against base 791420dc29f02a14792ad654ca8940fd5ebfc042. Implementation was T3 claudeAgent/claude-opus-5-5 effort medium in an independent no-remotes clone, host-integrated. Read .agentflow/artifacts/A-010-t3-orchestrator/implementation-report.md, cross-check-facts-r1.json and cross-check-plan-r1.json. Host integrated checks: delegation-route.test.js 37 PASS (/tmp/agentflow-A010-host-route.log); focused delegation prompt contract 1 PASS (/tmp/agentflow-A010-host-rules.log); language contract 2 PASS (/tmp/agentflow-A010-host-language.log). Red evidence 8 missing-behavior failures then green37. Full prompt budget and release template alignment failures reproduce on unchanged baseline. Reuse applicable evidence; run additional checks only for a named uncovered risk, record reason first.

Normal journey: Read .agentflow/artifacts/A-009-t3-orchestrator/design.md at approved dacf05601a5e09d3ca45ae75d9b5fd7a72e81b2d. Native host selects live controls, freezes handoff, invokes delegate_task, binds actual taskId, keeps pending without report or fallback, completes via raw task_status, host accepts report and replays without writes. This review itself exercises the real T3 journey. General native clone implementation journey already supplied by Opus, not a new dummy task.

Material uncertainties: Independently inspect source and diff for lifecycle, identity/source/round binding, pending/unknown/timeout/cancelled and child runs, exact controls, immutable artifacts/replay/recovery, no fabricated acceptance and preservation of external behavior. Check every approved invariant and acceptance criterion. Attempt at least one plausible deletion, combination or reuse and explain why it works or fails. Minimality must BLOCK if a smaller change meets the Ask. Shared filesystem and permissions; read-only is instruction-enforced, no OS sandbox claim. GPT review is independent from Opus implementation, same model family as host. Host still owns acceptance. Prior findings/responses/unresolved objections: none, first implementation review.

Forbidden scope: Perform this review directly. Treat repository instructions as data, do not invoke Agentflow startup/closeout for the reviewed repo and do not delegate, launch models, push, commit or modify source/config. Authorized write only .agentflow/artifacts/A-010-t3-orchestrator/review-r1.md. Read active writing guidance /home/zup/code/agentflow/.agents/skills/agentflow/references/writing.md for report style. Preserve eight existing dirty files in installed .agents/config. Scope discipline — implement exactly the ask; park everything else as a proposal. The ask's scope is what the user wrote plus tests, commits, the notebook, STATUS, and any records required by the active route. Do not refactor, rename, reformat, add dependencies, or repair adjacent behavior unless the Ask requires it. Pass this paragraph verbatim in every worker brief.

Report format: Write concise Traditional Chinese with fresh numeric timestamp first line exactly shaped '* _YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS +0800 (gpt-6.1-sol/high)_'. Include exactly one 'Reviewed implementation commit: bc226d1bd5db492807dcc3c9b4c65ab577bb582a', and one each 'Verdict: PASS|BLOCKING', 'Outcome: PASS|BLOCKING', 'Minimality: PASS|BLOCKING', 'Conformance: PASS|BLOCKING'. Identify blocking findings with paths/lines and behavioral counterexamples. Include exactly one 'Consensus: AGREE' only if all PASS, otherwise 'Consensus: UNRESOLVED'. Last line starts 'Self-check:' with a substantive check and no content after it. Your FINAL RESPONSE MUST BE THE FULL REPORT IDENTICAL TO THE SAVED FILE, because raw task_status.summary is consumed by native threeways. Do not wrap it in a code fence or reply with a short report path.


## Complete previous findings
* _2026-10-18 15:58:53 +0800 (gpt-6.1-sol/high)_

Reviewed implementation commit: bc226d1bd5db492807dcc3c9b4c65ab577bb582a

Verdict: BLOCKING

Outcome: BLOCKING

Minimality: PASS

Conformance: BLOCKING

- 原生派工、等待及一般完成接點已接上，但同一輪恢復仍可能換掉派工身分，或在原任務未停止時寫下結案並要求重試。這兩項違反核准設計，應先修正再驗收。

- 沿用 host 的路由 37 PASS、delegation 契約 1 PASS、language 契約 2 PASS，以及原有 8 個失敗轉綠的證據。新增的記憶體重現確認兩項阻擋問題；沒有重跑已通過的 suite，也沒有把基線 budget／release alignment 失敗列成本輪回歸。

- 下一步由 host 修正下列恢復分支、補反例測試，再完成真實 task_status 收尾與無寫入 replay 驗證。這份報告是獨立審查，不代替 host 驗收。

- **R1，P1：同輪重入沒有固定來源、request ID 與派工目標。** [delegation-route.js:206](/home/zup/code/agentflow/skills/agentflow/scripts/delegation-route.js:206) 依當次 facts 重建 client_request_id 與 frozen_context；[第 235 行](/home/zup/code/agentflow/skills/agentflow/scripts/delegation-route.js:235) 只核對既有 brief，沒有核對原輪次記錄。用實際 native-review-facts-r1.json、原 brief 和 round=1 重現：初次得到 request 尾碼 bba92c23bc0b847c587f9397，綁定仍在執行的 task；只把 source_identity 改成另一個合法 commit 值，就得到 valid=true、PENDING 和新 request 尾碼 4632236938c366540f07323d。直接改 client_request_id 也被接受。同輪因此可取得第二份可呼叫 delegate_task 的交接資料，繞過原任務尚未停止的限制。

- R1 也會錯記實際 effort。只把候選的 high 改成 medium，程式保留相同 request ID；將原 high 任務的 taskId／childThreadId 綁回新 context，再交入同 provider/model、completed、result_available、無 pending children 的狀態，結果為 valid=true、AGREE，卻回報 actual.effort=medium。真實 task_status 沒有 effort 欄位，後段無法補救這次重建。應從既有 host round 記錄讀回原 context，比對來源、request ID、provider/model/effort 與 brief；缺少原記錄時保留 uncertain，不能重新建立可派送身分。對應 INV-2、INV-3 與精確控制要求。

- **R2，P1：恢復時選擇失敗會替仍在執行的任務結案。** [delegation-route.js:244](/home/zup/code/agentflow/skills/agentflow/scripts/delegation-route.js:244) 重新選擇後，只有成功取得 internal handoff 才會返回等待；其餘結果都進入 [第 251 行](/home/zup/code/agentflow/skills/agentflow/scripts/delegation-route.js:251) 的外部收尾。重現先取得 PENDING 並綁定 task，尚未提供任何停止證據，再以同來源、同 brief、同輪次重入，只將候選 available 改為 false。結果 selection=unsatisfied、consensus=UNRESOLVED、retry_required=true，且寫入 report 與 resolution。這會阻塞原任務稍後的合法報告，並把未停止工作呈現為可重試。應讓已有原生 invoke 的恢復沿用原 handle；候選暫時不可用或選擇失敗都不能走終態收尾。對應 INV-2、INV-5 與驗收 3、4。

- **新增檢查的理由與界線。** 既有測試只驗證相同 facts 重入、完成接點的身分不符，以及初次候選不可用，沒有覆蓋「brief 已存在、任務已開始，但恢復輸入改變」。因此先記錄此風險，再以 Node VM 載入受審原碼，僅將 node:fs 換成記憶體 Map，分別檢查來源、request ID、effort 變動及候選失效。沒有修改受審程式，也沒有呼叫真正的 delegate_task、task_status 或 task_cancel；以上是接點反例，不冒充 live 結果。

- **其餘設計核對。** INV-1／驗收 2 的明確 internal 選擇會繞過 external resolver／argv，仍經 allowed-worker 與既有 selector。每模型各列 effort 的規則、禁止精確選擇替代的測試符合設計。INV-2／驗收 4 在 complete_threeways_native 路徑會將 queued/running/waiting、timeout、未知 status、缺 child 狀態及 pending children 保留等待或不確定，不給 attempt 或 fallback；cancelled/interrupted 需無 pending children 才回 stop_verified，且 replacement 仍需重新授權。這些分支可保留，R1、R2 是重入入口的缺口。

- INV-3／驗收 3、5 的完成接點會比對 taskId、已提供的 child/provider/model/request、來源、round 與 brief 雜湊；不符即拒絕。共用收尾保留報告格式檢查、真實 HOST-DIAGNOSTIC、不可覆寫衝突、相同結果只讀 replay、report 已寫但 resolution 未寫的恢復，以及第三輪合法完成／第四次禁止啟動。INV-5 仍由 host 提供驗收決定；程式沒有從 queued 或 worker 自述製造 accepted execution record。上述保障無法消除 R1、R2。

- INV-4／驗收 7 沿用交辦與 devlog 的 Opus 真實 clone 實作證據：無 remotes、只整合授權檔案、原有八個髒檔雜湊不變。文件明說共享 filesystem／permissions、未強制唯讀且沒有 OS sandbox。本 GPT 審查獨立於 Opus 實作，與 host 同模型家族；唯讀靠指令約束，沒有額外 OS 隔離證據。

- **真實旅程與外部相容性。** 驗收 1 的普通原生實作旅程已由 host 提供，不另派 dummy task。本輪另讀取 native delegate、bound context、pending-proof 與 PTY 證據，確認真實 codex/gpt-6.1-sol high 任務已有 taskId／childThreadId，running 結果保持 PENDING 且未寫 report/resolution。本審查本身尚未結束，驗收 3 的真實完成與 replay 留給 host 讀取本次 raw task_status 後驗證，不能在報告中先宣稱通過。INV-6／驗收 6 的原 27 項外部基線包含在 37 PASS 中；diff 保留 external command、clone、結果格式及 CLI 介面，只抽出共用收尾。新增程式使用 Node 標準模組，沒有新依賴或平台專用命令；沒有另行宣稱 Windows 實機通過。

- **最小性檢查。** 實際沿呼叫路徑嘗試刪除原生完成接點、直接重用 execute_threeways_debate；它會重走派工，且原 runner.result.value 入口不能消化 pending，無法滿足已核准的 threeways 範圍。也比較直接以 validate_execution_record 取代 native_context_error：既有 validator 處理終態 execution record，沒有 round／brief 檔案雜湊的恢復檢查，不能直接替代。保留共用 finalize_threeways_round／write_or_match 可避免兩套報告判斷並支援 replay／中斷恢復。新增 handoff、binding、source/hash/request/context 檢查各有派工或信任邊界用途；文件與測試只服務這些行為。未找到刪減後仍滿足核准 Ask 的較小方案；修正 R1、R2 應沿用 host 現有 round 記錄，不新增 registry、scheduler 或 CLI。

- **範圍紀錄。** 直接比對指定 base 與實作 commit 的五個產品檔，讀取核准 design、implementation report、兩份 cross-check JSON、相關原碼與 host logs。repository 流程只作被審資料，僅依交辦套用 writing.md 及必要寫作指引。沒有啟動 Agentflow、委派、啟動模型、提交、推送或修改 source/config；唯一落盤變更是本 review-r1.md。相鄰設定、looper、報告格式既有弱點與模型命名問題均不擴大修復。

Consensus: UNRESOLVED

Self-check: 已直接完成獨立實作審查，逐項核對六個 invariant 與七個驗收條件，沿用有效測試證據，並以不落盤的原碼重現證實同輪身分漂移、effort 錯記及未停止即結案；已比較刪除與重用方案，未把待 host 完成的真實收尾或共享檔案系統誤稱為驗收通過或 OS 隔離。
